nora: FYI I opened a tiny PR to add an embedding tier worked example + Grafana panel snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8402

devin: Thanks — can you paste the worked example copy here? Ill convert to python/js snippets.

nora: Simple example below. Show mapping of embedding_units to billing tiers and a screenshot hint for Dashboard. Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client=RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp=client.embeddings.create(model='open-embed-small',input=['hi'])
print(len(resp.data[0].vector))
```

devin: I'll fix the anchor and add a short JS snippet. Also will add a Grafana query suggestion: `sum(increase(redwood_billing_embedding_units_total[30d])) by (org_id)`. Add a note about month boundaries/timezone.

lee: From billing: confirm embedding_units aggregated monthly is the billing signal. Also ask to add reserved capacity sentence for enterprise.

nora: Done. Updated PR, fixed anchor, added reserved capacity note and batching/cache callout. CI re-run passes.
